## What this is

1.5.1 is 1.5.0 with the arm64 image added. The code is 1.5.0's, the chart changes only its version, and every setting, route, screen and tool is what 1.5.0 has, including an owner deleting a person.

## Why it is its own release

Multi-arch ships in its own run. 1.5.0 built amd64 only, and this is the one small version bump that builds both. From here `stable`, `latest`, `1.5`, `1` and `1.5.1` all list amd64 and arm64.

## Upgrading, and going back

No migrations. `helm upgrade` to 1.5.1, or let `:stable` roll the Quadlet units. An arm64 box that has been pulling the arm64 image 1.4.2 shipped now gets the 1.5.1 one. Putting 1.5.0 or 1.4.2 back is safe, because nothing in the database changed.
